title: "Chalk Stick"
description: A harmless little "Chalk" stick, that you can put in your mouth...
body:
### This is a little Blockbench experient
**_Disclaimer: This will make the Carved Pumpkin blur on screen be gone!_**

# HOW TO USE
**You NEED to have [this datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/custom-roleplay-data) _1.6 works_**

Create a world with the **datapack** and **resourcepack** enabled!

Type this command in: 
_/function custom_roleplay_data:set_required_level {level:0}_

Next hold a **carved pumpkin** and type this command: 
_/trigger CustomModelData set 1_

Then you are done!

You can put it on your head slot if you want (;
